title: Leaf decay fix
description: Small jar mod for 1.12.2 that fixes leaf decay.
body:
### What does it do?
Makes so that naturally generated leaves don't decay up to 8 blocks instead of 4, which fixes big jungle and oak trees. Also ignore the modloader, i had to choose one.

### Installation
Add this mod to your minecraft jar on MultiMC or Prism launcher.
### Incompatible with
- Forge (Leaves dont drop when broken with shears, they also may not decay after breaking all nearby logs, other than that it's playable)
- Dynamic Trees (Crashes the game)
- Anything (probably) that changes arr.class (BlockLeaves.java)
### Works only on 1.12.2!
